paragraphs: 2. Configure your firebase ( - Add Authentication and Sign-in method with Email/Password - Create Realtime Database and add rules from firebase/database.rules.json (paste them in the console or run firebase deploy --only database) - Add notifications to the news node in Realtime Database: > > { > "news": { > "2026-10-example": { > "date": "2026-10-13", > "title": { "pl": "Tytuł", "en": "Title" }, > "text": { "pl": "Treść powiadomienia", "en": "Notification text" } > } > } > } > Each user can mark a notification as read, it is saved in users/{uid}/newsRead. - Firebase Storage is not needed,…
